Method of Attack: Remote access tool (RAT) allowing full control over Windows systems
Used in spear-phishing attacks with malicious Microsoft Office documents containing macros
Capabilities include administration, surveillance, proxy, anti-theft
Delivered via spear-phishing emails purporting to be official communications
Impacted Systems: Windows operating systems starting from XP including server editions
Service providers in energy and maritime industry
Attack Vector: Spear-phishing emails with malicious Microsoft Office documents (Excel and Word)
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious Microsoft Office documents with blurred content to entice macro enabling
Emails purporting to be from Turkish Revenue Administration
